decisions.reason: As a low-complexity accessory that builds directly on the firm’s track-system business, it likely meets modest aspiration levels and is cheap to carry in a growing premium lighting market.

A LED luminaire is close to the firm’s core offer and brand position, so absent clear signs of underperformance management would usually retain it, though single luminaires are somewhat exposed to portfolio pruning and design renewal.

The home automation server box is adjacent but more technologically uncertain and support-intensive than core luminaires, so if its results are ambiguous or below aspiration the firm is likely to reallocate resources toward its stronger lighting lines or new developments.

A luminaire family fits the firm’s established premium assortment, showroom logic, and retailer presentation concept, making continued retention likely unless sales clearly fall short of aspiration levels.
